hypotheses.A: The pre-peak high-to-price component of 12-to-1-month momentum is less crash-prone and more complementary to priceOnly than total or residual momentum, so a small HTP rank tilt can improve both error and direction.
hypotheses.B: A sparse downside guard applied only to stocks that rank in the top HTP and top PTH quintiles can add downside detection to the low-error priceOnly forecast without causing excessive false warnings or magnitude error.

formationWindow: From 252 trading sessions before origin through 21 sessions before origin, using adjusted closes strictly earlier than origin. HTP=log(max(window)/first(window)); PTH=log(last(window)/max(window)); total momentum=HTP+PTH.
ranking: Within each origin, use deterministic average-rank percentiles. Map percentile p to score 2p-1. Missing features do not enter ranks and fall back to priceOnly.
candidateA: priceOnly * exp(0.025 * HTP rank score). The coefficient is fixed before feature collection and outcome evaluation.
candidateB: priceOnly * exp(-0.05) only when both HTP and PTH percentiles exceed 0.80; otherwise priceOnly. The intersection is intended to identify long-run winners still near their formation-period high, not to target a desired warning count.
totalMomentumControl: priceOnly * exp(0.025 * total-momentum rank score), using the same rank transform and coefficient as candidate A.
simpleTrend: exp(horizon/126 * trailing-126-session log return ending before origin); no fitted parameters.
evaluation: Fixed last half of latest-main origin dates: 9 origins for 126 sessions and 8 origins for 252 sessions. Retain every row and every missing-input fallback. Historical outcomes have already been observed, so results are exploratory only.
training: No fitted model, label selection, class balancing, or target-sign quota. Same-origin cross-sectional ranks use only adjusted closes dated before origin. Horizons are evaluated separately. Duplicate CIK/origin observations are rejected.
direction: Final numeric ratio >1.02 up, <0.98 down, otherwise neutral. Direction comes only from the final numeric value; no classifier argmax or probability is attached.
weighting: Equal total weight per origin for headline metrics; preserve unweighted pooled metrics, each date, and each market regime.
extraGate: Apply existing blend gates against priceOnly and noChange: date-mean future-price MAPE and return MAE both improve at least 2%, tails do not worsen, date win rate is at least 60%, direction/balanced direction/up/down recall/down precision pass. Also require falseDownWarningRate no worse than priceOnly and errors no worse than simpleTrend. Prospective remains false.
dataCollection: After registration, retrieve Yahoo chart payloads once and freeze compact past-only features plus URL, retrieval time, row range, and raw payload SHA256. Revised adjusted prices and current constituent identities are not point-in-time evidence.
probability: Not applicable. Numeric tilts emit no calibrated probabilities; Brier and log loss remain null.
abstention: No abstention. Neutral forecasts and priceOnly fallbacks remain in full-sample metrics.
knownBias: Current constituents, current identities, revised adjusted prices, and previously inspected historical outcomes remain. PIT membership/lifecycle readiness is 0/34, so no candidate can be promoted from this experiment.
